primary_endpoints: Per independent start: 0-4 integration_synthesis mean over 4 integration probes
Per independent start: 0-4 priority_resolution mean over 4 conflict probes
primary_comparisons: Hybrid minus factual under token-matched mode on integration
Hybrid minus factual under token-matched mode on conflict
secondary_comparisons: Narrative vs factual and symbolic vs factual under matched mode
All three alternative arms vs factual under natural mode
Differences in arm effects between natural and matched modes
Single-field retrieval performance and unsupported-claim control
interpretation: Screening: consider promising if at least one primary delta >= 0.5/4 and neither retrieval nor unsupported-claim control falls more than 0.25/4. Report all scores and model-family variation; not powered for confirmatory claims.
sample_unit: Independent fresh start for each persona x model x arm x budget; probes in a start are correlated.
token_budget: Actual versioned target tokenizer. Match each strategy up to the maximum natural length for that persona/tokenizer, 0 to 5% shorter, never longer; preserve and report neutral filler verbatim. Natural mode is required too.
blinding: Scorers blind to technique identity, random ordering; human calibration gates specified and approved before trusting automated judge.
unfinished_pre_execution_items: Pin exact model IDs and model-family independence
Obtain and checksum exact deployed tokenizer(s) and chat template overhead
Fix decoding settings, context budget and random seeds
Approve human calibration and scoring process
freeze_rule: These documents, fields, answer keys, comparisons and rubric are immutable for v1 after a first scored run. Future revisions require v2 and new data.
exclusions: No claimed hidden-session memory, no personal memory imports, no model-run claims from authored answer keys.
